chose: The game essay's template takes home's week file as agreed with the server worker. Each bite is filed where home's week file puts it (`placement`: before the game, a half, or after it), since only home knows whether a bite with no half of its own came before the first play or after the final; the check holds a matched bite to its play's quarter and bites to their order within each placement. A bite said first and never mapped keeps a null scenario, which the stage is to say as "Said first". Whose voice says a bite is code's (`gameVoiceOf`), for the writer to set: the owner's choice when they made one, else read aloud below an average word confidence of 0.70 (READ_ALOUD_BELOW, the prototype's bar), else the owner's voice. Version 1 is amended in place, since no essay has been written at it.
options: Home says each bite's placement (chosen): home alone can tell a bite said before the first play from one said after the final, so the essay files where home put it.

gray: Where a bite with no half appears, what an unmapped bite shows, and the confidence below which the second voice reads a bite are what the owner sees and hears in every essay; D5 and D10 set the direction, not these lines.
